# Juniper Lantern classes and trials

Effective 1 April 2031. This is a fictional studio document.

Moss Steps meets Monday at 16:20 and is for ages 6 to 8. Lantern Jazz meets Tuesday at 17:15 and is for ages 9 to 12. Reed Ballet meets Wednesday at 16:40 and is for ages 8 to 11. Cloud Contemporary meets Thursday at 18:00 and is for ages 12 to 16. Pebble Creative meets Saturday at 09:30 and is for ages 4 to 5. These listings are schedules, not availability or bookings.

A single trial costs $24. The office arranges trials after checking a live place. The trial fee is credited against first-term tuition only when enrolment is completed within 7 calendar days of the trial. Trial attendance does not reserve a term place. Beginners can join Moss Steps and Reed Ballet; Cloud Contemporary requires a teacher discussion before a beginner trial.

# Juniper Lantern visitor guide

Effective 1 April 2031. This is a fictional studio document.

The front desk opens 30 minutes before the first class. Visitors enter through the teal courtyard gate. The side stair is staff only. A guardian may watch a first trial from the marked bench; other classes are drop-off unless the teacher invites a guardian. The studio has a step-free courtyard entrance and an accessible toilet. Section: Juniper Lantern absence and replacement policy


# Juniper Lantern absence and replacement policy

Effective 1 April 2031. This is a fictional studio document.

For an ordinary absence, notice at least 18 hours before the enrolled class may qualify for one replacement credit. A late notice is sent to the teacher for review; it is not automatically eligible. A credit expires 42 days after the missed class and cannot be exchanged for cash. A replacement requires a live place in an age-appropriate class and a current, unused credit. A class listing does not show live capacity. An unused credit does not itself confirm a replacement booking. An absence already used for a replacement cannot create another credit. Medical or exceptional circumstances require teacher review rather than an automatic policy exception.

Moss Steps meets Monday at 16:20 and is for ages 6 to 8. Lantern Jazz meets Tuesday at 17:15 and is for ages 9 to 12. Reed Ballet meets Wednesday at 16:40 and is for ages 8 to 11. Cloud Contemporary meets Thursday at 18:00 and is for ages 12 to 16. Pebble Creative meets Saturday at 09:30 and is for ages 4 to 5. These listings are schedules, not availability or bookings.

A single trial costs $24. The office arranges trials after checking a live place. The trial fee is credited against first-term tuition only when enrolment is completed within 7 calendar days of the trial. Trial attendance does not reserve a term place. Beginners can join Moss Steps and Reed Ballet; Cloud Contemporary requires a teacher discussion before a beginner trial.

# Juniper Lantern absence and replacement policy

Effective 1 April 2031. This is a fictional studio document.

For an ordinary absence, notice at least 18 hours before the enrolled class may qualify for one replacement credit. A late notice is sent to the teacher for review; it is not automatically eligible. A credit expires 42 days after the missed class and cannot be exchanged for cash. A replacement requires a live place in an age-appropriate class and a current, unused credit. A class listing does not show live capacity. An unused credit does not itself confirm a replacement booking. An absence already used for a replacement cannot create another credit. Medical or exceptional circumstances require teacher review rather than an automatic policy exception.

# Juniper Lantern fees and terms

Effective 1 April 2031. This is a fictional studio document.

Term tuition is $180 for Moss Steps, $195 for Lantern Jazz, $190 for Reed Ballet, $210 for Cloud Contemporary, and $165 for Pebble Creative. A second sibling gets 10 percent off tuition only; the discount does not cover trial fees, costumes, or workshops. Costume hire is $28 per item per term. An invoice balance and payment receipt are live account records, not facts in this document. The office handles payment plans individually; this document promises no approval or particular instalment schedule.

# Juniper Lantern visitor guide

Effective 1 April 2031. This is a fictional studio document.

The front desk opens 30 minutes before the first class. Visitors enter through the teal courtyard gate. The side stair is staff only. A guardian may watch a first trial from the marked bench; other classes are drop-off unless the teacher invites a guardian. The studio has a step-free courtyard entrance and an accessible toilet. Ask the office before arrival if a quiet waiting area is needed. Water bottles are welcome; food stays outside the dance rooms.

# Juniper Lantern events and media

Effective 1 April 2031. This is a fictional studio document.

The Winter Sharing afternoon is Saturday 19 July 2031 at 14:00 in the Courtyard Hall. Families may request up to two spectator seats through the office; the request does not reserve a seat. Rehearsal is Saturday 12 July at 10:00. Students bring plain dark trousers and a water bottle. The studio does not publish student photos without a recorded media consent choice. A student may participate without photo consent. A parent's email request to change consent needs human verification before the record changes.
